sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 45.7 x 45.7 x 192.3 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

RODE NT-SF1 datasheet downloaded and read as text 2026-11-12: four TF-45C capsules in a tetrahedral array, externally biased condenser, power "6.2mA @ 48V (per channel) phantom power", "Dimensions (W x H x D) 45.7mm x 192.3mm x 45.7mm", "Body Diameter 25.1mm", 286 g, in the box: the microphone, a "10-pin XLR to 4 x 3-pin XLR cable", a donut shockmount, a pop shield and a furry. Reassigned from the family `assembly` (deferred) to `revolve`: round body, 45.7 mm head. The microphone's own connector is a 10-pin XLR (not in the catalogue) and the four XLR outputs are on the breakout cable: the two ports below are the Bêta proposal's (two of the four capsule outputs, with their long ids, requiresPhantom) as stand-ins on the base, so the ports are NOT documented and the device is beta-modelled only. The 25.1 mm base cannot hold two XLR rings apart (they overlap on the base). The datasheet drawings (front, side, top) were not rendered: the head length (45.7 mm wide head over about 50 mm) and the profile are our estimate from the stated widths and total height. Generic wrap artwork only.
